page: Microsoft Azure D1plds_v7 is an entry-level virtual machine instance belonging to the general-purpose Dpldsv7 family. It operates on the 64-bit ARM architecture under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is configured with 1 dedicated arm64 vCPU and 2.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation. Hardware acceleration is absent, with 0 GPUs assigned to this instance.

For temporary storage, the D1plds_v7 comes provisioned with a 59 GB local NVMe solid-state drive and supports Premium Storage remote disk configurations. It is provisioned without complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating standard Azure networking primitives or private routing configurations for connectivity.

Given its minimal footprint of 1 vCPU and 2.0 GB RAM alongside local NVMe storage, this instance offers an economical profile for lightweight workloads that do not require x86 instructions. The primary operational constraint is its constrained memory ceiling. It is suited for lightweight microservices, low-traffic web serving, development sandboxes, basic automation scripts, and background task workers adapted for ARM64.
